title: DONEGAL GROUP INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Donegal Group Inc., a small NASDAQ-listed insurance holding company, filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026 reporting the results of its annual shareholder meeting held on April 16, 2026. Stockholders elected five directors and approved both an advisory say-on-pay vote and the ratification of KPMG LLP as the company's independent auditor for 2026.
key_points: Annual meeting held April 16, 2026 with 8,165,424 votes represented out of 8,719,393 total eligible votes.
Five directors elected: Kevin G. Burke, David C. King, Annette B. Szady, Melissa A. Veenstra (Class A, 3-year terms) and Michael K. Callahan (Class C, 2-year term).
Advisory vote on named executive officer compensation passed with 7,768,261 votes for, 101,028 against, and 2,285 abstentions.
Ratification of KPMG LLP as independent auditor for 2026 passed with 8,116,587 votes for, 48,443 against, and 394 abstentions.
The company is headquartered at 1195 River Road, Marietta, Pennsylvania and trades on NASDAQ under symbols DGICA and DGICB.
